answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the crystal record and indexed in the echo history, the sable audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 65 aliases thus needs 65 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 6 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
